title: ttf-ternary: training ternary language models without master weights
description:
Code for two-timescale threshold flips (TTF): training ternary ({-1, 0, 1}) language models without full-precision master weights, from scratch or from a converted ternary checkpoint. The weights stay packed at 1.6 bits during training; the optimizer state is low-rank (about one byte per weight). Includes the trainer, packed-ternary Triton kernels, pipeline and data parallel training, evaluation and inference code. The conversion of pretrained models is the separate ttf-conversion package; ttf-home exports trained models to GGUF for llama.cpp.
